text:
Type: large striped flatwoven area rug
Use: anchoring a living or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: smooth flat weave, wool-look yarn, finished short ends
Colors: off-white cream, black stripes
Shape: large rectangle with thin black horizontal lines growing denser toward a dark center band, flat thin profile, graphic
Feel: crisp, calm, airy, graphic
Goes with: white walls, light wood, black metal, grey textiles; Scandinavian, Japandi or minimalist living rooms

product.name: RISTINGE
product.description: Handwoven by skilled craftspeople, each one is unique. Made in India in organised weaving centres with good working conditions and fair wages.
